requirements.statement: Aliases are revisioned convenience names and never durable actor identities.
Signature verification and exact route authorization are both required before append.
Replay identity and content digest make inbound acceptance exactly-once and conflict-detecting.
Federation time windows and route traces are finite and fail closed.
Production federation uses a dedicated HTTPS transport surface.
Federated messages carry information but no local execution or memory authority.
Organizational DAG and budget lineage is invariant across federation.
Outbound uncertainty is reconciled by exact delivery identity through the supported operator path.
